info.title: Bily API
info.description: Discover stores, read analytics and commerce data, inspect connections, and run explicitly authorized actions with the Bily API.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Discover the identity and organizations attached to a key.

tags.name: Store data
tags.description: Read store profiles, readiness, catalogs, and connected accounts.

tags.name: Commerce
tags.description: Run scoped commerce reads and explicitly approved GraphQL mutations.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Read normalized advertising, attribution, product, customer, and cohort metrics.

tags.name: Analytics SQL
tags.description: Run constrained read-only SQL over store-scoped Bily datasets.

tags.name: Customer journeys
tags.description: Read customer touchpoints within an authenticated store scope.

tags.name: Connections
tags.description: Inspect available connections, support, and advertising assets.

tags.name: Supported actions
tags.description: Synchronize connections and update supported advertising assets.

tags.name: Campaign actions
tags.description: Create or clone supported advertising campaign resources.

tags.name: Ad drafts and jobs
tags.description: Save, review, publish and reconcile immutable advertising changes.

tags.name: Creative library
tags.description: Analyze references and retain generated images separately from ad publication.

tags.name: Tracking connections
tags.description: List and manage store-scoped tracking connections without returning credential secrets.

tags.name: Tracking evidence
tags.description: Inspect installation, incoming receipts, reviewed events and destination evidence within one workspace.

post.description: Advanced immediate provider operation to rename, pause, resume, archive, or rebudget supported campaigns and ad sets, plus supported ad-level actions. Normal Ads Manager requests should saveAdDraft first, read/review it, then explicitly publishAdDraft. Meta and Google budget writes require the version 1 budgetGuard from read-asset-budget, exact selected native owner/parent and a budget-only update with the unchanged cadence. Old unguarded absolute/relative budget bodies require a new review and submit no budget change. Bily never rebases the saved absolute amount or retargets an inherited Meta ad set. Google shared scope must be complete and at most 100; CUSTOM_PERIOD is unsupported. Generic Google status/name/removal is checked against the exact fresh native campaign and parent; classic VIDEO and budgets affecting VIDEO are read only. Dedicated Demand Gen video remains supported; the native v24+ responsive Video-ad-info and experiment exceptions are not generic update-asset operations. Native-owner arbitration covers separate jobs and authorized aliases. New unguarded budget drafts fail Save; overbound mixed financial jobs require a split review. Busy or unknown outcomes never replay automatically; unknown outcomes quarantine the exact owner with its original receipt beyond job retirement. ARCHIVED maps to native removal for Google, TikTok and Snapchat; require separate exact destructive approval rather than treating it as a reversible pause. Authorized Slack requests use this same workspace-scoped capability; pausing an ad requires its exact platform, asset type, and asset ID. This generic outer sourceAuthority remains GOOGLE_ADS only; Meta budget source is bound inside budgetGuard. Other providers and nonbudget fields keep their previous contracts. This is an execution endpoint. For a reviewed user change, save its supported capability/body as an immutable action draft, review it, and explicitly publish that draft. Check action-jobs/capabilities before staging; a catalog entry alone does not make it stageable.

query.description: A GraphQL query. Mutations require allowMutation=true and the platform_actions:write API-key permission. Subscriptions are rejected.

apiVersion.description: Optional commerce API version in YYYY-MM format or unstable.

path.description: A relative resource path without a query string, such as orders or orders/123.

sql.description: Read-only SQL that starts with SELECT or WITH and reads from the scoped `_` alias.
sql.example: SELECT customer_id, total_revenue FROM _ ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

inputLimit.description: customer_ltv defaults to 50000 and allows at most 100000; cohorts defaults to 1000 and allows at most 5000. Small LTV limits select a top-revenue sample rather than the full customer population.

page.description: Compatibility field echoed in the response. It does not paginate this query; use SQL and maxRows to bound the returned rows.

startDate.description: Required for cohorts. For customer_ltv, scopes customers by first-order date; revenue remains lifetime revenue.

endDate.description: Required for cohorts. Must be on or after startDate.

FlexibleMetricRow.description: A normalized metric row. Available dimensions depend on the requested view and hierarchy.

bilyId.description: The Bily customer identifier whose journey you want to read.

dateFrom.description: First date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dateTo.description: Last date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

CustomerJourneyResponse.description: An ordered customer journey or touchpoint report.

pixel.description: The public pixel or tag identifier.

sourceAuthority.description: GOOGLE_ADS only: use the exact enabled account and connector pair from the current workspace selection. Omit for other platforms.

UpdateAssetRequest.description: For Meta/Google budget changes, first read the native budget and keep the returned guard unchanged. Send only budget and budgetType inside updates. Meta omits top-level sourceAuthority; its source is inside budgetGuard. Google supplies the exact top-level sourceAuthority pair. The path supplies resourceUrl; do not repeat it in the body.

connectionKey.description: An exact key from tracking connections. Defaults to website.

since.description: ISO timestamp within the last 120 minutes. Defaults to five minutes ago.

until.description: Optional past ISO timestamp at or after since.

eventName.description: Exact event name without contact details.

eventId.description: Opaque event ID without contact details.

baselineKeys.description: Comma-separated baseline keys from test-baseline. At most 200 keys.

filter.description: Search retained event names and public scalar values.

email.description: Exact case-insensitive email match. Send only in the JSON body, never the URL.

params.description: Public scalar event parameters. Sensitive identity, credential and reserved keys are rejected.

NativeBudgetGuard.description: Use the live quote unchanged. amountUnits must fit a positive signed 64-bit integer (at most 9223372036854775807). Selection, owner, currency, cadence and source must match the exact request. Google affectedCampaignIds is the complete unique lexically sorted scope, includes the selected campaign, and matches referenceCount. A JSON-shaped guard without a current matching fingerprint is not executable authority.

NativeBudgetSnapshot.description: When canEdit is true, budgetGuard is present and every selection, owner, amount, cadence, currency and source field matches it. Otherwise reason is present and there is no budgetGuard. Do not invent a guard or reuse one for a different owner.

expiresAt.description: Retention deadline as Unix seconds; a non-null pinnedAt retains the creative beyond this deadline.

name.description: No emojis. Han, Hiragana and Katakana characters count twice toward the 512-character native limit.

budget.description: Account currency. Require the current supported minimum and currency precision; lifetime minimum depends on scheduled days.
